card.title: T-34 76 PL
card.flavorText: The T-34 was a Soviet medium tank that was produced and used during WWII by the Red Army and their Allies. Quite a few T-34 tanks were provided to the armored formations of the Polish Armed Forces in the East. For example, the 1st Armoured Brigade of the 1st Polish Army, also known as Berling’s Army, had many T-34 tanks in their service. This unit fought many hard battles, including the Warsaw Uprising and the Battle of Berlin.
